source_summary: Vertical Chinese landscape painting with misty ink-wash mountains, distant water craft, a spreading pine, layered foreground trees and rocks, and a small scholar crossing a rustic bridge. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from all motifs.

motifs.name: upper_cliff_peak
motifs.description: Isolate the tall upper cliff face and summit mass near the top center-left, excluding the inscription and red seals to the right. Keep the pale ochre cap washes, vertical contour lines, dark crevice strokes, small dotted texture marks, and soft grey-brown ink shading along the central rock face.
must_preserve: soft wash transitions on the rock face

motifs.name: upper_right_dark_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the dark sloping mountain ridge descending on the upper right, separated from the calligraphy area above. Preserve the triangular ridge silhouette, dense black-grey rubbing strokes, layered brown washes, and the mist-softened lower edge.

motifs.name: left_mist_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the broad horizontal bank of mist and cloud wash spreading from the left edge into the central mountain gap. Keep the diluted grey ink blooms, feathered edges, and translucent overlaps with the pale background, without including calligraphy or distinct mountain masses.

motifs.name: middle_conical_peak
motifs.description: Isolate the central middle-distance conical mountain rising from the mist. Preserve its dark clustered ink strokes, ochre accent dabs near the crest, rough rocky side contours, and the cloud-softened base.

motifs.name: water_pavilions_boats
motifs.description: Isolate the two small roofed craft or pavilion-like boats floating in the misty water at lower left-center. Include their fine roof geometry, red-orange hull and wall accents, thin ink outlines, and the faint surrounding water wash needed to read them as distant boats.

motifs.name: spreading_pine
motifs.description: Isolate the large leaning pine in the middle-lower right, including the bent trunk, branching limbs, and all visible needle clusters. Preserve the dark needle rosettes, knotted brown trunk strokes, forked branch structure, and small rock base beneath it.
must_preserve: small base rocks and root strokes

motifs.name: foreground_grove_cliff
motifs.description: Isolate the layered foreground grove and rocky bluff below the pine, with several dark tree trunks, ochre-brown foliage masses, and the sloping rock ledge. Preserve the broken ink outlines, foliage dabs, dry-brush cliff texture, and grey wash shadows around the trunks.

motifs.name: scholar_bridge_rocky_shore
motifs.description: Isolate the small scholar figure crossing the rustic bridge at the lower center-left with the adjacent rocky shore and nearby water edge. Preserve the tiny figure outline, robe strokes, bridge planks and supports, dark shoreline ink, rounded boulders, and sparse water marks.
motifs.role: scholar figure with bridge and rocky shore

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
